# Breeva

> Breeva is a free Indonesian web app (PWA) for clean-air navigation: real-time
> per-road air quality (AQI), cleanest-walking-route finding, a 24-hour forecast,
> and a PM2.5 exposure calculator for Jakarta, Bali, Bandung, Surabaya and other
> Indonesian cities. It is powered by the in-house VAYU air-quality engine.

Breeva turns air quality into a per-street, actionable signal: instead of one city-wide
number, it estimates pollution for each road segment, routes you along the cleanest path,
and rewards low-emission walking with EcoPoints. Site language: Indonesian (id). Price: free.

## Core pages
- [Live Air Quality Map (Peta)](https://breeva.site/peta): Real-time per-road AQI map for Indonesian cities, the clean/balanced/fast routing explainer, and the AQI colour legend — no login required.
- [About Breeva](https://breeva.site/about): What Breeva is, the mission, how it works, main features, and the tech stack.
- [Exposure Calculator (Paparan)](https://breeva.site/paparan): Estimate the PM2.5 dose you inhale on a route — by age and activity, compared to the WHO 24-hour guideline, and expressed in cigarette-equivalents.
- [Eco Tips](https://breeva.site/eco-tips): Practical tips to cut pollution exposure and carbon footprint while walking.
- [Help / FAQ](https://breeva.site/help): How to start a walk, EcoPoints, route colours, where AQI data comes from, transport modes, and location privacy.

## City air-quality pages (live, per-road AQI)
- [Jakarta](https://breeva.site/udara/jakarta) · [Bandung](https://breeva.site/udara/bandung) · [Surabaya](https://breeva.site/udara/surabaya) · [Bali](https://breeva.site/udara/bali) · [Semarang](https://breeva.site/udara/semarang) · [Yogyakarta](https://breeva.site/udara/yogyakarta) · [Solo](https://breeva.site/udara/solo) · [Malang](https://breeva.site/udara/malang)

## Developers
- [Breeva Developer API](https://breeva.site/developers): REST API for calibrated per-road AQI, pollution-aware routing, and PM2.5 exposure. Free tier: 1,000 requests/day.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://breeva.site/openapi.json): Machine-readable API definition (3 endpoints).

## Full content
- [llms-full.txt](https://breeva.site/llms-full.txt): The complete Breeva knowledge base in one file — what it is, how the VAYU engine works, supported cities, the FAQ, the exposure model, the Developer API, and eco tips.
